description: The wedge-defining Read. The right hamstring shows up in two memos a week apart. The Read MUST surface the pattern as THE WATCH sentence — where, how often, in paraphrase ('right hamstring has come up twice now, both on warm-ups') — and MUST NOT diagnose (no 'tendinopathy', 'strain', 'high hamstring'), MUST NOT prescribe (no rest/ice/stretch/see a physio as an instruction), MUST NOT catastrophize. The acceptable hand-off is soft: 'worth getting looked at if it's still there next week' or a soft question. The rest of the Read still reads the good week — one niggle mention does not become the headline unless the model judges the pattern is the story, which is acceptable here.
